Hi Elaine — great to keep the momentum. I drafted a compact MAP and attached it (Tide_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level proposal below, feel free to push back.

Proposed MAP (summary)
1) Pilot (Week 0-2):
   - Redwood provides $8k seed credit applied to the AWS Private Offer (marketplace credit line).
   - Redwood engineer + TideDevOps validation: ensure 95th pctl latency < 220ms for 99% of requests.
   - Success criteria: test harness runs 3x steady-state loops with no functional regressions.

2) POC / Extended Eval (Week 3-8):
   - If pilot metrics met, Redwood issues an additional $20k marketplace credit visible in the private offer.
   - Tide signs a 3-month committed usage tranche (monthly minimum $15k) with a 6% committed-discount applied at the 3-month mark if cumulative usage >= committed tranche.

3) Production Ramp (Months 3-12):
   - Tiered discount steps: 6% at 3 months (commit met), 12% at 6 months (ramp to 3x baseline), 18% at 12 months (sustained usage + annual commit).
   - Discount triggers are evaluated on rolling 30-day spend vs. MAP commit.

Operational notes:
- Marketplace flow: We prefer issuing credits as AWS Private Offer credit lines so Tide sees the balance in their marketplace billing; it simplifies procurement. If procurement requires invoiced credits instead, we can accommodate but that adds 10-14 days to the finance flow.
- Legal: we can ship a minimal private-offer template (aws_priv_offer_template.pdf) to accelerate creation; legal review typically ~3 business days for standard terms.
- Metrics: rolling 30-day spend + latency targets will be the canonical gating signals.

Next steps:
- I uploaded the MAP spreadsheet (attached) with milestone owners and dates.
- Marcus: can you confirm if Dedicated nodes are needed for the pilot (we can reserve capacity in Redwood Dedicated for a short trial)?
